searchText: Spec sheet It’s updated regarding metrics for the number of saved datacolumns I think it makes sense especially with validator custody but it should be modified to avoid confusion on the blocks without blobs, this should be solved somehow The metric being discussed `beacon_custody_columns_count_total` https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-metrics/pull/14 another point is do we need to observe anything else custody related from the updated specs? Ex. `custody_group_count` Thanks for everyone who joined the breakout call today! Summary: - All clients have made good progress and are mostly devnet-4 ready 🎉 - `peerdas-devnet-4` will be launched shortly 🚀 - Teams started discussing `peerdas-devnet-5` scope and ways to test distributed blob building. - There were some discussions to add more details to validator custodty and distributed blob building in the consensus spec. - Pari will start a poll on moving this call to a 3pm UTC from the next call, and change this breakout call to weekly! More details in meeting notes here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ng2IrCe28kTt1BnIsjtMlKHq2MHgaja24LhFXSvqfJQ/edit?usp=sharing Forgot to mention that one thing we need to eventually do is (imo) follow through with what we discussed at Devcon about proofs being computed by transaction senders and going in the network wrapper for blob txs in the mempool. Not sure if anyone from the EL reads this chat, but if so, what do we need to make this happen? As a reminder, the idea was: sender gives you a blob with all proofs, you extend the blob and verify all proofs <@199561711278227457> about the prysm memory leak, what is the limit you used? How would we feel about merging the basic validator custody PR (https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3871) this week? Before the next cl-specs release. First we'd make changes regarding backfilling... > specifying that the advertised custody should not be updated until after backfilling, in case your balance increases and makes your custody increase too (so you don't get requests you can't answer), and being explicit about the requirement to backfill cc <@520034910149410861> not for devnet4 scope, right? Correct. Not for devnet4.

excerpts.author: jimmygchen
excerpts.content:
Thanks for everyone who joined the breakout call today!

Summary: 
- All clients have made good progress and are mostly devnet-4 ready 🎉
- `peerdas-devnet-4` will be launched shortly 🚀
- Teams started discussing `peerdas-devnet-5` scope and ways to test distributed blob building.
- There were some discussions to add more details to validator custodty and distributed blob building in the consensus spec.
- Pari will start a poll on moving this call to a 3pm UTC from the next call, and change this breakout call to weekly! 

More details in meeting notes here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ng2IrCe28kTt1BnIsjtMlKHq2MHgaja24LhFXSvqfJQ/edit?usp=sharing
